defmodule ImagePipeline.Processor do
  @moduledoc """
  Image processing pipeline with graceful shutdown.
  Processes images through configurable transformation stages.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  defstruct [:queue, :workers, :shutdown_ref, :metrics_format]

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def process_image(path, transforms) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:process, path, transforms})
  end

  def get_metrics(format_template) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:metrics, format_template})
  end

  def graceful_shutdown(timeout \\ 5000) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:shutdown, timeout})
  end

  # --- Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    workers = Keyword.get(opts, :workers, 4)
    metrics_fmt = Keyword.get(opts, :metrics_format, "pipeline.%s.%s")

    state = %__MODULE__{
      queue: :queue.new(),
      workers: spawn_workers(workers),
      shutdown_ref: nil,
      metrics_format: metrics_fmt
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:process, path, transforms}, from, state) do
    sanitized_path = sanitize_path(path)
    job = %{path: sanitized_path, transforms: transforms, from: from}
    new_queue = :queue.in(job, state.queue)
    schedule_next()
    {:noreply, %{state | queue: new_queue}}
  end

  def handle_call({:metrics, format_template}, _from, state) do
    metrics = collect_metrics(state)
    formatted = format_metrics(metrics, format_template, state)
    {:reply, {:ok, formatted}, state}
  end

  def handle_call({:shutdown, timeout}, from, state) do
    ref = Process.send_after(self(), :force_shutdown, timeout)
    drain_queue(state)
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | shutdown_ref: ref}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:process_next, state) do
    case :queue.out(state.queue) do
      {{:value, job}, rest} ->
        execute_job(job, state)
        {:noreply, %{state | queue: rest}}
      {:empty, _} ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info(:force_shutdown, state) do
    Logger.warning("Force shutdown triggered")
    {:stop, :shutdown, state}
  end

  def handle_info({:EXIT, pid, reason}, state) do
    new_workers = handle_worker_exit(pid, reason, state.workers)
    {:noreply, %{state | workers: new_workers}}
  end

  @impl true
  def terminate(reason, state) do
    log_shutdown(reason, state)
    :ok
  end

  # --- Private Functions ---

  defp spawn_workers(count) do
    Enum.map(1..count, fn id ->
      pid = spawn_link(fn -> worker_loop(id) end)
      {id, pid}
    end)
  end

  defp worker_loop(id) do
    receive do
      {:execute, job, parent} ->
        result = run_transforms(job.path, job.transforms)
        send(parent, {:result, job.from, result})
        worker_loop(id)
      :stop ->
        :ok
    end
  end

  defp execute_job(job, state) do
    case List.first(state.workers) do
      {_id, pid} -> send(pid, {:execute, job, self()})
      nil -> Logger.error("No workers available")
    end
  end

  defp run_transforms(path, transforms) do
    Enum.reduce(transforms, {:ok, path}, fn
      transform, {:ok, current_path} ->
        apply_transform(current_path, transform)
      _transform, error ->
        error
    end)
  end

  defp apply_transform(path, {:resize, width, height}) do
    cmd = "convert #{path} -resize #{width}x#{height} #{path}_resized"
    case System.cmd("sh", ["-c", cmd], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {_, 0} -> {:ok, "#{path}_resized"}
      {err, _} -> {:error, err}
    end
  end

  defp apply_transform(path, {:rotate, degrees}) do
    cmd = "convert #{path} -rotate #{degrees} #{path}_rotated"
    case System.cmd("sh", ["-c", cmd], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {_, 0} -> {:ok, "#{path}_rotated"}
      {err, _} -> {:error, err}
    end
  end

  defp apply_transform(path, _), do: {:ok, path}

  defp sanitize_path(path) do
    path
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.\/]/, "")
    |> Path.expand()
    |> then(fn expanded ->
      if String.starts_with?(expanded, "/srv/images/") do
        expanded
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid image path"
      end
    end)
  end

  defp collect_metrics(state) do
    %{
      queue_depth: :queue.len(state.queue),
      worker_count: length(state.workers),
      uptime_seconds: System.monotonic_time(:second)
    }
  end

  defp format_metrics(metrics, template, state) do
    base_format = state.metrics_format
    # Build metric lines using the user-provided template for metric names
    # and the base format for the metric path
    metrics
    |> Enum.map(fn {key, value} ->
      metric_name = :io_lib.format(to_charlist(base_format), [template, key])
      # User template controls the value formatting
      formatted_value = :io_lib.format(to_charlist(template), [value])
      {to_string(metric_name), to_string(formatted_value)}
    end)
  end

  defp schedule_next do
    Process.send_after(self(), :process_next, 10)
  end

  defp drain_queue(state) do
    :queue.to_list(state.queue)
    |> Enum.each(fn job ->
      GenServer.reply(job.from, {:error, :shutting_down})
    end)
  end

  defp handle_worker_exit(pid, reason, workers) do
    case Enum.find(workers, fn {_id, p} -> p == pid end) do
      {id, _} ->
        Logger.info("Worker #{id} exited: #{inspect(reason)}")
        new_pid = spawn_link(fn -> worker_loop(id) end)
        Enum.map(workers, fn
          {^id, _} -> {id, new_pid}
          other -> other
        end)
      nil ->
        workers
    end
  end

  defp log_shutdown(reason, state) do
    remaining = :queue.len(state.queue)
    Logger.info("Pipeline shutting down. Reason: #{inspect(reason)}, remaining jobs: #{remaining}")
  end
end
